sentences.text:
For Respondent(s) : Ms. Meenakshi Pareek PP HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KANWALJIT SINGH AHLUWALIA -/Order/-
20/08/2018 Mr. Anuroop Singhi, the learned counsel for the petitioners, inter alia, contends that no notice was received by the petitioners under Section 13(2) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act to apply for second sample.
The learned counsel for the petitioners in support thereof has relied upon Para 10 and 11 of the petition.
It is further contended that shelf-life of second sample had expired due to deterioration and therefore, the petitioners have been deprived of a valuable right.
It is further contended that after sanction was obtained by the Food Inspector impugned complaint was filed after a period of four years.

Reliance has been placed upon decision of co-ordinate Bench of this Court in Varun Beverages Ltd.
vs. State of Rajasthan, SBCRLMP No. 2756/2014 decided on 25.10.2016.
Issue notice to the respondent for 31.10.2018.
